facts.business: Coffee Day Enterprises Limited operates in the coffee business through its subsidiary Coffee Day Global Limited (running Café Coffee Day outlets) and in the resort/hospitality business.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure contracted but not recognised as liabilities

auditor.name: M/s. Venkatesh & Co
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Disclaimer of opinion on consolidated financial statements due to unrecoverable dues from MACEL amounting to ₹3,357.13 crores, non-compliance with debt covenants, lack of balance confirmations from lenders (₹76.98 crores), material uncertainty over going concern for multiple subsidiaries, and doubts on recoverability of capital advance of ₹275 crores in a subsidiary.

key_risks: Recoverability of dues from MACEL (₹3,357.13 crores)
Non-compliance with debt covenants and loan repayment defaults
Material uncertainty over going concern for multiple subsidiaries
SEBI penalty of ₹26 crores under appeal
Recoverability of capital advance of ₹275 crores for land acquisition
Climate variability and irregular rainfall affecting coffee production
Rising input costs and labour availability in coffee business
facts.related_party_note: Trade receivables from related parties amount to ₹19.42 crores as at 31 March 2026. Capital advance of ₹275 crores given to Mrs. Vasanthi Hegde (promoter group) for land purchase. Subsidiaries have advanced amounts to MACEL (related party).
